source.provider: Indiana 3DEP LiDAR products hosted by Purdue GDSL/iDiF; AWS open-data bucket
source.source_date: 2011-2013 statewide Indiana LiDAR program; tile key identifies 2013; exact flight date not specified in file metadata
source.horizontal_resolution: 5 US survey feet (1000 x 1000 cells per 5000-foot tile)
source.vertical_product: Normalized Digital Height Model: surface/object height above underlying ground; provider states 5-ft GSD
source.vertical_unit_limit: The tile declares the horizontal CRS unit as US survey feet but does not explicitly declare the raster value unit. Values are retained in native units; feet-to-meter values below are interpretations, not surveyed measurements.
source.license: Indiana Statewide Elevation Catalog states CC0; URL https://registry.opendata.aws/in-elevation/

mask.input_geometry: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 Feature 638 exact CQNE ring in WGS84
mask.transform: WGS84 to EPSG:2966 using PROJ/PyProj; no local degree approximation for raster sampling
mask.pixel_center_mask: centers of 5-ft raster cells inside the transformed GIS polygon

cross_section.axis: 12 equal-width bands across the short footprint axis (south to north)
cross_section.interpretation: central bands are higher than outer bands, supporting a longitudinal gable roof profile; narrow-pixel sampling and unknown vertical unit leave pitch and eave exact values unverified

uncertainty: The 2013 statewide tile has 5-ft cell spacing; each cell averages roof and edge effects.
No explicit vertical-unit or accuracy field is embedded in this normalized-height tile; retained raw native values and labeled conversion avoid presenting an estimate as a measurement.
The vertical source predates the 2000-2006 Cary renovation; external roof height/form are assumed unchanged only at broad-massing level.
The footprint mask comes from an independent Purdue facility GIS record and can include overhang/outline differences.
